description: Creates a battle in setup and returns its token. With nobody named it starts a draft with only you at the table, reusing your untouched draft with the same mission pack, and returns joinUrl: anyone with an account who opens it joins the open place, and the draft becomes a battle once every place is filled and every army chosen. opponentId seats one opponent from list_my_opponents for a duel; opponentIds seats one or two, and allyId seats a friend on your side, for a 2v1 or doubles. Every seat belongs to an account; to track a game alone, seat a practice opponent. limit is the battle size in points (1000, 2000, 3000, or 600 for King of the Colosseum); omit it to take the size from the rosters, as a draft always does. missionPackId is a mission pack id from list_reference. casual: true plays it outside a tournament both players are entered in. manual: true tracks by hand without mission cards, stratagems or CP automation. groupToken counts it for a group both players are in, and fixture names that group's league fixture. Then set it up with submit_battle_action, following get_my_battle's next. Requires mcp:write.
name: create_battle
title: Create a battle
